title: Sep 30 Results + Oct 1 Preview: A Split Decision Kind of Day
summary: We went 2-2 on Sep 30, but here's what tomorrow's Braves matchup is telling us

content.value:
## Here's the Thing About September Baseball

So, September 30th gave us one of those perfectly balanced days—the kind where you win some, you lose some, and you're reminded that baseball has a beautiful way of keeping us humble. We finished 2-2, landing right at 50%, and honestly? There's a story worth telling in each of these games.

## How the Day Unfolded

Let me walk you through what happened. We had confidence in four matchups, each with our model leaning at least 50% or higher. The Braves and Astros didn't come through for us despite decent probability edges, but the Yankees and Padres delivered exactly what we hoped for.

## What I'm Watching: The Misses

The Braves loss stings a little because, well, we're going back to that same matchup tomorrow. Sometimes the best teams have off nights—that's the human element of this game that no model can fully capture. The Astros? Similar story. High confidence, unexpected outcome. These are the games that make you better at reading the next day's slate.

## Tomorrow's Story: Phillies-Braves, Take Two

And speaking of tomorrow—we've got a rematch that feels like unfinished business. The Phillies head back to Atlanta, and our model is once again leaning toward the Braves, though with a bit less swagger this time at 57%.

content.title: ⭐ Oct 1 Top Pick
content.sub: 57% win probability vs Phillies · Ray Kerr on the mound

content.value:
## The Pitching Matchup to Know

Aaron Nola brings his veteran presence for Philadelphia, while Atlanta counters with Ray Kerr. Here's what makes this interesting: after dropping yesterday's game, the Braves are playing at home with something to prove. The model sees a narrow edge, but it's the kind of edge that tells a story about home-field advantage and bounce-back potential.

Nola's been steady all season, so this isn't a gimme by any means. But there's something about the way Atlanta sets up tomorrow that has our numbers intrigued—just enough to make them our top pick for October 1st.

## Moving Forward

A .500 day isn't glamorous, but it's honest work. We learn from the misses, celebrate the hits, and come back tomorrow ready to see what the next chapter brings. That Braves-Phillies matchup? It's got sequel energy written all over it.

Let's see if Atlanta can flip the script.

author: Hana
